entities.name: Azusa
entities.description: A legendary traveling kannushi from Kamigawa, pupil of Dosan, who founded the Living Historians.

entities.name: Iwamori of the Open Fist
entities.description: Fellow order member who thought Azusa a master tracker.

entities.name: Reki
entities.description: Co-founder with Azusa of the Living Historians.

entities.name: Living Historians
entities.description: Group founded by Azusa and Reki to preserve history.

entities.name: Itsuki
entities.description: Current leader of the Living Historians who found Azusa's final diary.

events.summary: Azusa left Jukai after almost eight years to explore Kamigawa.
events.quote: Azusa left to explore Kamigawa's corners

events.summary: After the Kami War Azusa began documenting the lives of those affected.
events.quote: she began to document the lives and stories of those affected by the Kami War

events.summary: Azusa and Reki founded the Living Historians.
events.quote: Together with Reki , she founded the Living Historians

events.summary: Azusa traveled into the Tendo Peaks and vanished; her final diary was later found by Itsuki.
events.quote: Azusa was last known to be traveling deep into the Tendo Peaks
